faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get answers to the most common questions about outdoor advertising with Hyde Media

booking.question: How do I book an advertising location?
booking.answer: Contact us through our contact form, email (theodor.staal@hydemedia.ch), or phone (+41 77 233 81 21). We'll discuss your campaign goals, show available locations, and provide a customized quote within 24 hours.

duration.question: What is the minimum campaign duration?
duration.answer: Scaffolding campaigns typically run 1-6 months (tied to construction duration), while facade campaigns start at 3 months. We offer flexible options based on your needs and budget.

pricing.question: How much does outdoor advertising cost?
pricing.answer: Pricing depends on location visibility, size, and duration. Scaffolding campaigns typically start from 15'000 CHF/month for smaller formats, while facade advertising ranges from 25'000-100'000 CHF/month depending on size and location. Contact us for a free quote.

priceIncludes.question: What's included in the price?
priceIncludes.answer: Our all-inclusive pricing covers: design consultation, high-quality printing, professional installation, maintenance throughout campaign, permits and municipality approval, insurance, and removal. No hidden fees.

design.question: Do you provide design services?
design.answer: Yes! We have experienced designers who specialize in large-format outdoor advertising. We'll help you create designs that are visible from 50+ meters away, with optimal readability and brand impact. Design consultation is included.

timeline.question: How long from booking to campaign launch?
timeline.answer: Typical timeline: 1-2 weeks for permits and design, 3-5 days for printing, 1-2 days for installation. Most campaigns go live within 3-4 weeks from booking. Rush options available.

permits.question: Do I need permits for outdoor advertising?
permits.answer: Yes, most outdoor advertising requires municipality permits. Don't worry - we handle all permit applications, municipality communication, and ensure full compliance with local regulations. This is included in our service.

locations.question: What locations are available in Basel and Zurich?
locations.answer: We have premium locations in high-traffic areas including city centres and main arterial roads. Check our Scaffolding and Facade pages for current availability, or contact us for locations matching your target audience.

difference.question: What's the difference between facade and scaffolding advertising?
difference.answer: Scaffolding: Temporary (1-6 months), placed on construction scaffolding, quick setup, lower cost, flexible. Facade: Long-term (3+ months), permanent building installations, larger formats, maximum visibility, higher investment. Both deliver exceptional results.

measurement.question: How do you measure campaign performance?
measurement.answer: We provide traffic data (weekly passersby), location demographics, and visibility analysis. For some locations, we can arrange third-party impression tracking. You'll receive detailed reach reports.

weather.question: What about weather resistance?
weather.answer: All our materials are weather-resistant, UV-protected, and designed for Swiss weather conditions. Materials are tested for wind loads up to 30 m/s and remain vibrant for years.

targeting.question: Can I target specific audiences?
targeting.answer: Absolutely! We help you select locations based on demographics, traffic patterns, and your target audience. Whether you're targeting commuters, shoppers, or specific neighborhoods - we have strategic locations.

cancellation.question: What if I need to cancel or change my campaign?
cancellation.answer: Cancellation terms depend on campaign status: Before production starts - full refund. During production - partial refund. After installation - no refund, but we can discuss modifications. We're flexible and work with you.

installation.question: How is installation done safely?
installation.answer: All installations follow Swiss work safety regulations. Our certified installers use professional equipment, safety harnesses, and proper anchoring systems. We carry full liability insurance and never compromise on safety.

brandApproval.question: Do property owners approve which brands appear?
brandApproval.answer: Yes, property owners have full approval rights over all campaigns. We only work with quality brands and ensure campaigns align with property owner values.

process.description: Simple, transparent, and professional from start to finish

step1.title: Initial Contact
step1.description: Reach out to us with information about your property or scaffolding. We'll assess the opportunity and provide initial feedback.

step2.title: Site Inspection & Evaluation
step2.description: We visit the location to evaluate visibility, accessibility, and potential. You'll receive a detailed proposal with revenue estimates.

step3.description: We prepare all necessary agreements and handle municipality permits. For associations, we provide materials for board meetings and resident information.

q1.question: How much income can I expect?
q1.answer: Revenue depends on location visibility, size, duration, and campaign type. We provide detailed estimates after site evaluation. Typical campaigns range from several thousand to tens of thousands of CHF per month.

q2.question: Do I need special insurance?
q2.answer: No. All campaigns are covered by our comprehensive insurance that includes property damage, installation, and third-party liability. You're fully protected.

q3.question: How long does a typical campaign last?
q3.answer: Campaign durations vary. Scaffolding campaigns typically run 1-6 months (duration of construction). Facade campaigns can range from 3 months to several years depending on the agreement.

q4.question: What about permits and municipality approval?
q4.answer: We handle all permit applications and municipality communication. We have extensive experience with regulations across Switzerland and ensure full compliance.

q5.question: How do you handle resident communication for associations?
q5.answer: We provide professional information materials for board meetings and resident notifications. Clear timelines, campaign details, and revenue sharing information included.

q6.question: Can I reject certain brands or campaign types?
q6.answer: Absolutely. You have full approval rights over which campaigns appear on your property. We only proceed with campaigns you're completely comfortable with.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Hyde Media ("we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.

personalData.title: Personal Data
items: Name and contact information (email, phone number)
Company name and business information
Communication preferences

usageData.title: Usage Data
items: Browser type and version
Pages visited and time spent
IP address and device information

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
items: To provide and maintain our services
To communicate with you about campaigns and opportunities
To improve our website and services
To comply with legal obligations

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing and Disclosure
dataSharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data with:

Legal authorities when required by law

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

gdprRights.title: 6. Your GDPR Rights
gdprRights.intro: Under GDPR, you have the right to:

Correct inaccurate data
Request deletion of your data
Object to processing
Data portability

cookies.content: We use cookies to improve your experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Essential cookies are necessary for the website to function.
